name: Noroware Miko Imouto Hatsujou Kitan
original_name: 呪われ巫女妹発情奇譚
source:
You and your younger sister get locked inside your family’s storehouse. Without warning, she goes into heat and throws herself at you, frantic with desire. An old journal you find in the storehouse offers a chilling explanation.

“Unless she receives vital essence at regular intervals, she will die.”

To save her life, you cross a line no brother should cross. But there’s more to this “curse” than you realize. Its true cause lies in a secret your sister has been keeping…
Can you save your sister, or will her curse hold you captive for the rest of your life?​
